# Analyze HEB Requirement

Analyze the requirement below.

1. Identify the affected HEB application.
2. Identify frontend, backend, database, API, test, and deployment impacts.
3. Inspect existing implementation patterns.
4. Identify dependencies and integration points.
5. Identify security and data considerations.
6. Produce acceptance criteria.
7. Produce an implementation sequence.
8. Identify risks and open questions.

Do not modify code.
